summary: Linn County, OR cupola cabin on Yellowstone Mountain, dated 1921 by the register; sources disagree on its removal (1970) and ruin (by 1993). Gone.

facts.status_note: The register and firelookout.com say it was in ruins by 1993; Forest Lookouts gives 1970 as the removal year

notes_for_editor: Dates conflict. Register and firelookout.com say built 1921; Forest Lookouts quotes a station in charge in April 1913, a newly established lookout in May 1925 and a new lookout being erected in August 1926. Removal conflicts: Forest Lookouts says removed in 1970; register and firelookout.com say in ruins by 1993. The record's gone status rests on these entries; no source we read describes the site today. Ray/Roy Cather spelling varies across 1940-41 items. The Linn County Fire Patrol name comes from the Forest Lookouts pages; the register uses Linn FPA. A WebSearch found no independent source for the cabin. Record photo is the register's own; no new photos.
